verge_labs/club_automation.description: Find and book courts (tennis, squash, pickleball, padel, racquetball) at a club whose member portal runs on Club Automation. Signs in as you with your portal email and password; the keep holds the session, and your agent never sees either.…

verge_labs/github.description: Read and write GitHub issues, pull requests, files, and commits via the GitHub REST API. One connection = one primary owner/repo. For multiple repos create multiple connections backed by the same plugin type.

verge_labs/google_calendar.description: Create and manage Google Calendar events via the Calendar REST API v3.

verge_labs/google_calendar_oauth.description: Create and manage Google Calendar events via the Calendar REST API v3.

verge_labs/google_drive.description: Read and write files in Google Drive — including editing native Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides — via the Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides REST APIs.

verge_labs/google_drive_oauth.description: Read and write files in Google Drive — including editing native Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides — via the Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides REST APIs.

verge_labs/google_people.description: Look up people in a Google Workspace organization via the People API v1. Returns names, email addresses, phone numbers, job titles, and departments. Read-only.

verge_labs/google_people_oauth.description: Look up the people in your Google Contacts — family, neighbours, the plumber, the kids' school. Returns names, email addresses, and phone numbers. Read-only.

verge_labs/home_assistant.description: Control Home Assistant entities from agents. The daemon templates HTTP calls in-process — no subprocess plugin is spawned for this plugin. Configure with your HA instance URL and a long-lived access token.

verge_labs/home_assistant_music_assistan.description: Play music around the house through Music Assistant on Home Assistant — ask for an artist, album or playlist by name, control transport and volume per room, group speakers, and move what's playing from one room to another.

verge_labs/sonos.description: Control Sonos speakers from agents — play and pause, skip, set volume, start a favourite or playlist in a room, group and ungroup rooms, and play a short announcement clip.

verge_labs/spotify.description: Play music on Spotify from agents — search the catalogue and start something, control transport and volume, move playback between speakers, queue tracks, and save what's playing. REQUIRES SPOTIFY PREMIUM and a one-time setup step: you…
